_provenance.paper: L. W. Whitlow, S. Rock, A. Bodek, E. M. Riordan, S. Dasu, 'A precise extraction of R = sigma_L/sigma_T from a global analysis of the SLAC deep inelastic e-p and e-d scattering cross sections', Phys. Lett. B 250 (1990) 193; preprint SLAC-PUB-5284
_provenance.transcribed: 2026-09-23, from the rendered pp. 7-8 of the local copy (Eqs. (6)-(7) and the parameter sentence)
_provenance.licence: preprint scan served by INSPIRE; only the functional form and three fit parameters are transcribed (facts), with attribution
_provenance.why_here: R1990 is the R inside HERMES's b1^d (their ref. [18]); LiPolGen carries only R1998 (r1998) and the toy r_sigma_lt, so the harness rebuilds F1^d with this form and PRICES the difference to r1998.
_provenance.validity: fit to 0.1 <= x <= 0.9, 0.6 <= Q^2 <= 20 (SLAC) plus CERN data; 'should not be used for Q^2 <= 0.3 (GeV/c)^2'. HERMES's first bin (x = 0.012, Q^2 = 0.51) is below the SLAC x range: an extrapolation, as it was for HERMES.
_provenance.typo_note: The SLAC-PUB scan prints 'b1 = 0.635'. The value used is 0.0635 (the published PLB value, the one every R1990 implementation carries). Evidence it is a typo: at x = 0.3, Q^2 = 3 the form gives R = 0.187 with 0.0635 (r1998 there: 0.193) and R = 0.49 with 0.635, 2.5 times the E143 world fit at the same point.
